messages:
Alex Kim: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need explicit owners and timelines so these items actually close. I'll map to Jira and /assign where needed. Actions I captured:
1) autoscaler race condition -> INF-3421
2) flaky end-to-end test -> INF-3422
3) recurring-incident detector & pager rules -> ENG-231
4) rollback runbook update + drills -> OPS-99
Please reply with who owns what and an ETA. If anyone needs to reassign, say so now. :clipboard:

Priya Singh: I'll take INF-3421 (autoscaler). Will triage today and aim for a patch by EOD Wednesday. Creating the ticket and adding my name.

Sam Rivera: Assign INF-3422 to me. I'll pair with QA (Dana) and target next sprint (starts Mon). Will add test matrix to the ticket. :white_check_mark:

Joel Martinez: I'll own ENG-231 (detector + pager rules) but need infra time. Proposed timeline: discovery 1 week, implementation 2 weeks -> target 3w. RACI suggestion: R: Joel, A: Maria Chen, C: Priya/Dana, I: Platform team. Anyone object?

Dana Lee: I can be QA consult for INF-3422. Also can help define acceptance criteria for ENG-231 alerts (no noisy flaps).

Maria Chen: Please add labels: `postmortem`, `p1`, `recurring`. Use the `pm-closure` board column for all PM action items. I approve the RACI for ENG-231. Maria Chen is A for that item.

Priya Singh: Created INF-3421: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3421 — added root cause notes and a small repro. ETA Wed EOD. Added checklist: patch, canary, monitor for 48h.

Sam Rivera: INF-3422 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3422 — assigning to Sam Rivera, label `e2e-flakiness`. Adding QA task and a flaky-test alert.

Joel Martinez: ENG-231 ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ENG-231. Putting provisional estimate 3w. Note: needs at least one dedicated infra slot for kernel tuning — @Priya might advise on priority.

Priya Singh: Ack on advising infra. I'll block time Wednesday afternoon to review the autoscaler fix and coordinate access for kernel tuning.

Dana Lee: Quick ask — can we add a small acceptance test that asserts alert suppression window? I'll add the case to INF-3422 checklist.

Alex Kim: RACI summary (for the record):
- INF-3421: R=Priya Singh, A=Maria Chen, C=Sam Rivera, I=Platform
- INF-3422: R=Sam Rivera, A=Maria Chen, C=Dana Lee, I=QA
- ENG-231: R=Joel Martinez, A=Maria Chen, C=Priya/Dana, I=Infra
- OPS-99: R=Ops team (TBD), A=Maria Chen, C=Alex Kim, I=All
If someone wants to swap, say now.

Sam Rivera: Fine with RACI for INF-3422. I'll add the QA checklist and schedule the pairing session.

Maria Chen: On OPS-99 (runbook), I nominate @Alex Kim to coordinate runbook edits and @deploy-bot to schedule a tabletop drill next quarter. Alex, can you take the coord role?

Alex Kim: I can coordinate OPS-99. I'll draft the runbook updates and propose drill dates. Putting an initial checkpoint for Fri 10am next week — can we make that recurring weekly until all actions closed?

Priya Singh: weekly check-ins sound good. I'll add a calendar invite once Jira tickets have the `pm-closure` label.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: tabletop drill placeholder created for 2026-04-05 10:00 UTC (will send reminders).

Dana Lee: One more thing — recurring incident pattern: I noticed similar failures every ~14 days correlated with a nightly batch job. Can we add the batch job to ENG-231 discovery notes? Might reduce scope if it's the root cause.

Joel Martinez: Good catch — adding that to ENG-231 backlog items. If it's the batch job, the detector scope changes to cron job anomaly detection + backoff logic.

Alex Kim: OK team — next concrete steps:
- Owners create/confirm Jira tickets and add `pm-closure` label (by EOD today)
- Priya: patch + canary for INF-3421 (ETA Wed EOD)
- Sam/Dana: e2e fixes and QA pairing (target next sprint)
- Joel: discovery + infra booking for ENG-231 (initial plan in 1 week)
- Alex: runbook draft + drill schedule (checkpoint Fri 10am)
I'll check back here Friday for status updates. Thanks everyone. :pray:
